This small maize piece is very small, and I do not like to buy too much chemical for a place like this unless I can divide one bag across my fields. I will put a little fertilizer here because maize shows it, but I will still depend on manure from home and our own hand work. I will keep my local seed because that is what I know well in this mixed plot, and I will not spend money on spray or hired men for this one.
